title: Local multiplication formula for the canonical transported kernel map
statement: Let $j:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion, $L$ invertible and $J^2=0$ [lem-sc-square-zero-ideal-tensor-unit]. Fix $n,e\ge0$, put $F=j^*(J\otimes L^n)$ and $N=(j^*L)^n$, and let $x:\mathcal O_Z\to N^{e+1}$. Let $U\subseteq X$ be open and $t\in\Gamma(U,L^{n(e+1)})$ whose degreewise adjunction-unit image equals the restriction of $(\mathrm{boundarySectionDegreeIso}_{n,e})^{-1}x(1)$. For every section $y\in\Gamma(U,K_n)$, the inclusion of $\mathrm{tensorBoundaryKernelMap}_{n,0,e+1}(\mathrm{id}_F\otimes x)(y)$ in $L^{n(e+2)}$ equals the tensor product of $t$ with the inclusion of $y$, using tensorPowAddIso inverse and the arithmetic identification $n(e+1)+n=n(e+2)$ [lem-sc-tensor-boundary-kernel-map-naturality]. No graded presentation or action is involved.

source.place: Tag 09MS, coherent-equation-ses and its graded direct sum; Tag 0B8S, cohomology-lemma-boundary-derivation-over-cup-product, first proof paragraph.

proof.text: Represent y uniquely as the image of z under boundaryIdealKernelIso. Construct p in the target ideal tensor by the explicit boundaryIdealTensorProduct applied to t tensor z. The multiplication inclusions intertwine this pairing with tensorPowAddIso by braiding naturality, associator naturality, and the left unitor.

Use normalization of the pullback tensor comparison and naturality of the adjunction unit to compute the unit image of p. Use the lift hypothesis and restriction naturality to identify the section-degree comparison of the unit image of t with x evaluated at 1. Apply the coefficient tensor pairing formula. The right unitor in source degree zero converts the resulting pure tensor into whiskering by x.

Expand the kernel-to-pushforward isomorphisms and cancel the ideal-kernel comparison on z and p. The preceding coefficient equality says that the transported kernel map sends y to boundaryIdealKernelIso(p). Injectivity of the target comparison proves this equality. Apply its inclusion equation and the explicit ideal-pairing inclusion identity from the first step to obtain the required formula.

lean.statement: theorem tensorBoundaryKernelMap_local_multiplication {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (j : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion j] (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (hI : j.ker ^ 2 = ⊥) (n e : ℕ) (x : 𝟙_ Z.Modules ⟶ (((tensorPullback j).obj L).tensorPow n).tensorPow (e + 1)) (U : X.Opens) (t : Γ(L.tensorPow (n * (e + 1)), U)) (ht : (tensorGradedUnit j (L.tensorPow (n * (e + 1)))).app U t = ((pushforward j).obj ((tensorPullback j).obj (L.tensorPow (n * (e + 1))))).val.map (homOfLE le_top).op ((x ≫ (boundarySectionDegreeIso j L n e).inv).app ⊤ (1 : Γ(Z, ⊤)))) (y : Γ(kernel (tensorGradedUnit j (L.tensorPow (n * (0 + 1)))), U)) : let F : Z.Modules := (tensorPullback j).obj (j.ker.toModules ⊗ L.tensorPow n) (kernel.ι (tensorGradedUnit j (L.tensorPow (n * ((e + 1) + 1))))).app U ((tensorBoundaryKernelMap j L hI n 0 (e + 1) (F ◁ x)).app U y) = (eqToHom (by congr 1; simp only [Nat.mul_add, Nat.mul_one, Nat.zero_add]) : L.tensorPow (n * (e + 1) + n * (0 + 1)) ⟶ L.tensorPow (n * ((e + 1) + 1))).app U ((L.tensorPowAddIso (n * (e + 1)) (n * (0 + 1))).inv.app U (tmulSection t ((kernel.ι (tensorGradedUnit j (L.tensorPow (n * (0 + 1))))).app U y)))
